summary: Denver's league-low-efficiency offense (31st in yards/play) faces a line that fell from -7.5 to -4.5, and the total is 43.5. Most likely winner: Denver ML (-225).

extra_legs.note: Denver's No. 9 EPA defense beats an Arizona team that is 2-4, allows 29.7 points and has lost nine straight at home.
The line moved 3 points toward Arizona, Denver scored 17 on 107 Nix passing yards, and most games land within one score.
Denver's offense scores 19 a game and its defense is No. 9 in EPA; my projection is 42.0 and Covers/Kalshi lean Under.

totals_projection.math: Raw ppg cross: DEN avg(19.0, ARI allows 29.7)=24.4; ARI avg(21.0, DEN allows 20.8)=20.9, sum 45.3. Adjusted down because ARI allowed 31, 36, 36, 45 to SEA/SF/NYG/DET offenses that are far better than DEN (31st yards/play, 259 ypg), so DEN ~22 and ARI ~20.

research:
SEARCH NOTE: about 13 WebSearch calls for this game plus the ESPN summary API (WebFetch fails with DNS errors, so only snippets). No sportsbook player-prop prices for DEN/ARI were findable, so no prop legs are offered.
1) Game: Denver (4-2) at Arizona (2-4), Sunday 4:05 PM ET, State Farm Stadium (roof/80F, effectively indoors). ESPN API.
2) Market: DraftKings (ESPN pickcenter) DEN -4.5 -110/-110, ML DEN -225/ARI +185, total 43.5 (o+100/u-120). Opened DEN -7.5, ML -360/+285, total 43.5. FanDuel (via FanDuel Research): DEN -4.5 -110/-110, ML -240/+198, total 43.5 -110/-110. Squawka lists 42.5.
3) No-vig: DK DEN ML 0.664, FD 0.678 (avg 0.671); DK total under 0.522, FD 0.50; spread both sides 0.50.
4) Line movement: the spread fell 3 points toward ARI all week; the total stayed at 43.5 but DK juice moved to u-120. No public ticket/money splits found.
5) Models: numberFire 62.9% DEN (FanDuel Research); ESPN matchup predictor DEN 68.6%; Squawka DEN 26-17 (editorial); Kalshi (Covers) ARI +4.5 54%, Under 43.5 53%.
6) Experts: Covers (early leans, Oct 21) takes Cardinals +4.5 and Under; SI preview has DEN -4.5 and flags Surtain/Hufanga injuries; FanDuel Research gives ATS DEN 4-2, ARI 3-3 and the Over only 1 of 6 in Denver games.
7) QBs: Bo Nix 114/189 (60.3%), 1,049 yds, 6 TD, 3 INT, all career lows; 107 yds in the 17-14 OT win over SEA (AP via ESPN). Payton took blame publicly. Jacoby Brissett 156/234, 1,328 yds, 9 TD, 6 INT; Carson Beck is listed questionable as the backup (ESPN injuries). Both starters are healthy.
8) Denver injuries (ESPN): CB Surtain questionable (ankle, returned to limited practice Wed per Broncos.com), S Hufanga OUT, RB Coleman questionable, RB Badie and LB Elliss IR. Arizona: G Gaines OUT, S Wingard OUT, CB Melton and S Baker questionable.
9) Stats (ESPN team stats): DEN 19.0 ppg, 259 ypg, 174.8 pass ypg, 84.2 rush ypg; allows 20.8 ppg, 230 pass ypg, 139.8 rush ypg. ARI 21.0 ppg, 318.8 ypg; allows 29.7 ppg, 247 pass ypg, 120.8 rush ypg. Sharp Football: DEN defense No. 9 in EPA/play and success rate, 5.0 yds/play allowed, 10 turnovers forced; offense 29th in success rate and 31st in yards/play (Covers). ARI 4.6 yds/play (28th).
10) Skill players: ARI Love 67-245-1 (rookie RB, no designation), McBride 49-361-3; DEN Dobbins 81-270-2, Waddle 22-228-1 (chest, limited Wed).
11) Recent form: ARI beat LAR 18-16 as a 13-point dog (six Ryland FGs) after losing 31-7 to SEA, 36-30 at SF, 36-24 at NYG, 45-21 vs DET. DEN beat SEA 17-14 OT, lost 24-14 at SF, beat LAC 23-17 and LAR 30-26, JAX 20-13.
12) Situational: ARI has lost nine straight at home (AP). First-year coach Mike LaFleur; Payton for DEN.
13) Weather: roof, 80F, 0% precip (ESPN/AccuWeather). No factor.
14) Total reasoning: the DEN game total went Over in only 1 of 6 (FanDuel Research); ARI games have run high (66, 60, 66 in earlier notes) because its defense is poor. Net: Under 43.5 has a slim edge from DEN's offense and defense, tempered by ARI's leaky D.
15) Role check: no prop legs, so no role issues to resolve. Love/McBride/Dobbins role is stable per ESPN leaders but no prop price was found.
16) Calibration: single-source fair (DK, with FD cross-check) for spread; ML and total priced at 2-3 sources. No big edge claimed. ARI +4.5 is a near-coin-flip.
17) Most likely to win: Denver ML (market 0.67, my view ~0.66).
